## Security checklist

- [ ] Server-side authorization and validation are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, raw IPs or visitor messages are logged.
- [ ] No raw user HTML is rendered.
- [ ] Email headers cannot be controlled by the visitor.
- [ ] Public serialized settings remain whitelisted.
- [ ] CSRF protection remains enabled.

## Documentation

- [ ] README or docs updated.
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated.
- [ ] English and Turkish translations updated for new strings.
